> **Scope decided 2026-11-19 (G1).** Lightweight SPL Memo transactions on
> Devnet, operator-signed. Full record:
> `docs/solana-integration.md`.

Record each round's identity and prediction deadline on Devnet so the deadline
is independently observable rather than only a database column. Operator-signed:
the operator genuinely owns the act of opening a round, so operator attestation
is the honest description.

Dependencies: `G1` (resolved 2026-11-19), `F8`, `F20` (for the shared Solana integration module and
config).

### Shape

Memo text `aisd:v1:round:<roundId>:<deadline ISO-8601>`, written when a round
opens. `purpose = 'round_record'` (type `tx_purpose`), `program_id` null. Recorded in
`blockchain_transactions` with `round_id` set and `idempotency_key` of
`round:<roundId>` — re-running the job for the same round hits 23505 instead of
writing a second, possibly contradictory, deadline.

The deadline is stored as an ISO-8601 UTC instant. `rounds.prediction_deadline`
is `timestamptz`; the memo must render it as UTC with an explicit offset so the
value is unambiguous and cannot be read in the operator's local zone.

### Acceptance criteria

- On-chain records can be correlated to an off-chain round by `roundId`.
- Deadline values are unambiguous: UTC, explicit offset, and identical to
  `rounds.prediction_deadline`.
- Retries do not create duplicate or contradictory records — one round yields at
  most one `round_record` transaction.
- A failure to record is visible (a `failed` row with the error) and never
  presented as confirmed.
- Devnet only; a non-devnet cluster is refused.

Source: `REQUIREMENTS.md`, `docs/solana-integration.md`.
